name: FOG Project (UEFI)
description: FOG Project's own iPXE feature selection for UEFI builds, as used by the FOG 1.6 installer.
notes: Derived by diffing FOG's src-efi/config headers against pristine upstream iPXE v2.0.0, the tag FOG pins its builds to. The revision list offered here is abbreviated commit hashes rather than tags, so that pin cannot be selected automatically -- options may not line up exactly on a much older or newer revision. Not expressible here: FOG's config/local/usb.h overlay (EFI USB keyboard support), the NO_WERROR=1 build flag, and FOG's multi-binary output matrix.
trust_note: Only upload a certificate if your FOG server was installed with HTTPS using its own CA (fogproject's -S / --force-https, which generates .fogCA.pem). A plain HTTP install, or HTTPS with a publicly trusted certificate, needs no certificate here -- and in that case FOG's own released binaries are the simpler choice.
embed:
#!ipxe
isset ${net0/mac} && ifopen net0 && dhcp net0 || goto dhcpnet1
echo Received DHCP answer on interface net0 && goto proxycheck

:dhcpnet1
isset ${net1/mac} && ifopen net1 && dhcp net1 || goto dhcpnet2
echo Received DHCP answer on interface net1 && goto proxycheck

:dhcpnet2
isset ${net2/mac} && ifopen net2 && dhcp net2 || goto dhcpall
echo Received DHCP answer on interface net2 && goto proxycheck

:dhcpall
dhcp && goto proxycheck || goto dhcperror

:dhcperror
prompt --key s --timeout 10000 DHCP failed, hit 's' for the iPXE shell; reboot in 10 seconds && shell || reboot

:proxycheck
isset ${proxydhcp/next-server} && set next-server ${proxydhcp/next-server} || goto nextservercheck

:nextservercheck
isset ${next-server} && goto netboot || goto setserv

:setserv
echo -n Please enter tftp server: && read next-server && goto netboot || goto setserv

:chainloadfailed
prompt --key s --timeout 10000 Chainloading failed, hit 's' for the iPXE shell; reboot in 10 seconds && shell || reboot

:netboot
chain tftp://${next-server}/default.ipxe || goto chainloadfailed
